# Reservation & Restaurant Management System

> Comprehensive PHP CodeIgniter Restaurant & Reservation Management Web Application

## Core Information
- **Language & Framework**: PHP (CodeIgniter 3.x)
- **Database Engine**: MySQL (`elitede1_rest`)
- **Key Modules**: Reservation, Order Management, POS, Kitchen Display, Counter Display, Waiter POS, Customer Web Portal

## Setup & Running
- **Launch Script**: `./start.sh`
- **Local URL**: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`
- **Database Dump**: `database/elitede1_rest.sql`

## Credentials Reference
- **Demo Credentials File**: `creds.txt`
